Sandbox_MultiSafehouse_AllowNonResidenti: When disabled (recommended), players can only claim residential houses with bedrooms or living rooms. When enabled, commercial, industrial, and public buildings can also be claimed.
Sandbox_MultiSafehouse_AllowSpawnBuildin: When disabled (recommended), buildings containing map spawn points cannot be claimed as safehouses. When enabled, players can claim spawn houses.
Sandbox_MultiSafehouse_MaxBasesPerPlayer: Maximum number of safehouses a single player may own simultaneously (0-100). Enter 0 for unlimited. Default is 28.
Sandbox_MultiSafehouse_MaxDimension_tool: Maximum building width or length (in tiles) that can be claimed as a safehouse. Default is 120.
Sandbox_MultiSafehouse_DaysSurvivedToCla: Number of in-game days a character must survive before safehouse claiming is permitted (0-365). Set to 0 to disable this requirement.
Sandbox_MultiSafehouse_AdminBypassRestri: When enabled, server administrators and debug mode players bypass spawn building, non-residential, and days survived restrictions.
